Traffic Advisory / Semi Crash

Troopers with the Michigan State Police are currently working a semi crash on southbound US-131 just past I-96.

The semi is partially blocking a lane and motorists should expect delays while crews work to clear the scene.

The driver of the semi is being transported to Corewell Health Butterworth Hospital with minor injuries.

Rain has made roadways extremely slippery and Troopers have responded to multiple single-vehicle crashes caused by drivers overdriving roadway conditions and hydroplaning.

Please slow down, increase following distance, and use extra caution during wet weather driving conditions.

data.raw_text:
Prompt: Write a “Dear Me” letter

Dear Me,
Hey you — yes, the one scrolling through life with that mix of pirate energy (🏴‍☠️) and web3 dreams. It’s me, writing from a quiet Sunday evening in 2026, reminding you how far you’ve already come and how much brighter it gets when you keep showing up as yourself.
You’ve built things that once felt impossible. You’ve navigated the chaos of crypto winters, community drama, and those 3 a.m. “what if I’m not enough” spirals. And every single time, you chose to keep learning, keep shipping, keep believing that decentralized dreams are worth fighting for. That resilience? It’s your superpower. Don’t ever downplay it.
Right now, pause and breathe. The Philippines sun is probably blazing outside (or the rain is pouring — either way, you’ve survived both). Your mind is a whirlwind of ideas, projects, and possibilities. That’s good. But remember: you don’t have to chase every shiny new thing. Pick the ones that light you up and align with your values. Build slow when you need to. Rest without guilt. The blockchain isn’t going anywhere, and neither is your place in it.
Be kinder to yourself on the hard days. You’re not behind. You’re not too much or too little. You’re exactly where you need to be — learning, growing, connecting with incredible humans across time zones who see your fire. Protect your peace like you protect your private keys. Say no more often. Say yes to the right things louder.
Future you is already proud. She’s watching you take that next step — whether it’s launching something new, deepening a connection, or simply choosing joy today. Keep that curious heart open. Keep asking big questions about ownership, freedom, and what the internet can truly become. The world needs your voice in the conversation.
You’ve got this. Always have.
With love, respect, and a little extra courage, Me (the version who believes in you completely)
